senses: v. 玩耍；（体育活动）参加（比赛）
n. 戏剧；剧本 v. 播放；演奏
play.usage: [族] player n. 运动员；[近] drama n. 戏剧

ex.en: Economic factors play a crucial role in determining how families respond to policy changes.
ex.zh: 经济因素在决定家庭如何应对政策变化方面起着关键作用。

ex.en: Injuries among young players have risen sharply since professional academies began intensive training at earlier ages.
ex.zh: 自职业青训营开始在更小的年龄进行高强度训练以来，年轻运动员的受伤人数急剧上升。

ex.en: The new playground was designed with soft surfaces to reduce injuries from falls.
ex.zh: 新操场采用了软质地面设计，以减少跌落造成的伤害。

ex.en: Multiple studies have linked long working hours to heart disease, though the exact mechanism remains unclear.
ex.zh: 多项研究表明长时间工作与心脏病存在关联，不过其确切机制仍不清楚。

senses: n. 请求，恳求；答辩；借口，理由
plea.usage: 这个单词是please（请）的名词形式。乞求一个人时总说“Please, please”，所以plea就是“恳求”。；索引p414

ex.en: Relief agencies issued an urgent plea for food and medicine for the flood victims.
ex.zh: 救援机构紧急呼吁为洪灾灾民提供食物和药品。

ex.en: The defendant entered a plea of not guilty at the start of the trial.
ex.zh: 被告在庭审开始时申辩无罪。

ex.en: He refused to help, using the pressure of work as his plea.
ex.zh: 他以工作压力大为由拒绝帮忙。

senses: vt. （法庭上）为（案件）辩护；以……为理由

phrases.p: plead with sb. to do sth.

plead.usage: 过去式/过去分词 pleaded 或 pled；plea（恳求）的动词。过去式/过去分词pleaded或pled（美）。近beg vt.乞求；串词记忆：请(please)让我为你辩护(plead)；索引p414

ex.en: First, the object of our study pleads for definition.
ex.zh: 首先，我们需要定义所研究的对象。

ex.en: The defendant pleaded guilty to the charges and asked the court for leniency.
ex.zh: 被告对指控认罪，并请求法庭从宽处理。

ex.en: She pleaded with the landlord not to raise the rent before winter.
ex.zh: 她恳求房东入冬前不要涨租。

ex.en: Despite pleas from residents, the council approved the construction of the new car park.
ex.zh: 尽管居民再三恳求，市议会还是批准了新停车场的建设。

senses: adj. 令人愉快的,舒适的

ex.en: The survey found that a pleasant working environment matters more to staff than small pay rises.
ex.zh: 调查发现，对员工而言，宜人的工作环境比小幅加薪更重要。

ex.en: The restaurant changed its menu to please younger customers who prefer lighter dishes.
ex.zh: 这家餐厅调整了菜单，以取悦偏好清淡菜肴的年轻顾客。

senses: n. 高兴；愉快；欣慰；休闲；乐事

phrases.m: 愉快地,高兴地,十分愿意

ex.en: He took great pleasure in proving that the widely accepted theory was flawed.
ex.zh: 他从证明那个被广泛接受的理论存在缺陷中获得了极大乐趣。

senses: vt. 许诺,保证,发誓;用……抵押
v. 保证给予（或做）；正式承诺；发誓
pledge.usage: [近] promise vt. 承诺；n.誓言，保证，承诺 v.保证，发誓；抵押；发音类似"铺了纸"→他在桌上铺一张纸写下"诺言"→诺言；誓言；易混:promise侧重主观意向;guarantee含若违背则予以补偿之意;pledge尤指公开或正式作出的保证；索引p414

ex.en: The government pledged their support for the plan.
ex.zh: 政府保证支持这个计划。

ex.en: The Government has pledged to change the law to introduce a minimum service requirement so that, even when strikes occur, services can continue to operate.
ex.zh: （英国）政府已承诺修改法律，引入最低服务标准，这样的话，即便发生罢工，（铁路）服务仍能继续进行。

ex.en: The company pledged to cut carbon emissions by half within ten years.
ex.zh: 该公司承诺在十年内将碳排放量减半。

senses: adj. 许多的，大量的，丰富的
plentiful.usage: [族] plentifully ad. 大量地；[近] abundant a. 丰富的（链P298）；拓展：plenty of 大量；很多。

ex.en: In those days jobs were plentiful.
ex.zh: 那个时期工作岗位多得很。

ex.en: Fish are plentiful in the cold waters of the North Atlantic.
ex.zh: 北大西洋寒冷的水域中鱼类资源丰富。

ex.en: Cheap labor is no longer plentiful in the coastal manufacturing belt.
ex.zh: 沿海制造带的廉价劳动力已不再充足。

ex.en: Rain fell plentifully throughout the spring, and farmers expect the best harvest in more than a decade.
ex.zh: 整个春季雨水丰沛，农民们预期将迎来十多年来最好的收成。

ex.en: There is plenty of evidence that regular sleep improves learning.
ex.zh: 有大量证据表明规律的睡眠有助于学习。

ex.en: There was an implicit warning in the governor's remarks, although no direct criticism was ever voiced.
ex.zh: 州长的讲话中含有一个隐含的警告，尽管自始至终没有人提出直接的批评。

plight.usage: ply（折叠）+-ight→被折叠压住的处境→困境。近predicament n.困境；dilemma n.进退两难；人处于困境(plight)的时候，只要看到光(light)就有希望

ex.en: The African elephant is in a desperate plight.
ex.zh: 非洲象正处于一种绝境之中。

ex.en: The charity seeks to draw attention to the plight of homeless families.
ex.zh: 该慈善机构力图引起人们对无家可归家庭困境的关注。

ex.en: Reports of the sailors' plight prompted an international rescue effort.
ex.zh: 关于船员困境的报道促成了国际救援行动。

ex.en: The explosion at the chemical plant prompted an investigation into whether safety inspections had been properly carried out.
ex.zh: 化工厂发生的爆炸促使人们展开调查，追问安全检查是否得到了切实执行。

senses: n. 故事情节；布局；阴谋
plot.usage: 发音类似“扑（p）捞它（lot）”→包掉河里要“密谋”如何打捞。

ex.en: Dickens crafted complex plots and striking characters.
ex.zh: 狄更斯精心设计了复杂的情节和引人注目的人物。

ex.en: Police uncovered a plot to smuggle weapons across the border.
ex.zh: 警方破获了一个偷运武器过境的阴谋。

ex.en: They plotted the ship's course on the chart before setting sail.
ex.zh: 启航前，他们在海图上标绘了船的航线。

ex.en: Farmers once ploughed their fields with horses, a method that disappeared almost completely within a single generation.
ex.zh: 农民曾用马拉犁耕地，这种方法在短短一代人之内几乎完全消失。

ex.en: Heavy autumn rain often prevents farmers from ploughing their fields before winter, delaying the following year's planting.
ex.zh: 秋季的暴雨常常使农民无法在入冬前翻耕土地，从而延误来年的播种。

ex.en: The marketing ploy succeeded in attracting younger customers, though some critics dismissed it as a superficial gesture.
ex.zh: 这一营销手法成功吸引了较年轻的顾客，尽管一些批评者认为这不过是表面功夫。

ex.en: Through sheer pluck and months of practice, the amateur crew finished the race despite damaging their boat.
ex.zh: 凭着过人的胆量和数月的训练，这支业余船队在船体受损的情况下仍然完成了比赛。

senses: v. (plugged) 堵塞;给……接通电源;连接

phrases.m: 接通(电源)；把(插头)插进(插座)

ex.en: She pulled the plug from the socket before repairing the lamp.
ex.zh: 修理台灯前，她把插头从插座上拔了下来。

ex.en: Workers used concrete to plug the hole in the dam.
ex.zh: 工人们用混凝土堵住了大坝上的缺口。

ex.en: The bank is struggling to plug the widening gap in its finances.
ex.zh: 这家银行正努力填补日益扩大的资金缺口。

senses: adj. 紫红色的;好的;值得拥有的

ex.en: After years of temporary contracts, she finally landed a plum position at a leading research institute.
ex.zh: 在做了多年临时工作之后，她终于在一家顶尖研究机构获得了一份称心的职位。

ex.en: The plumber traced the leak to a joint hidden behind the kitchen wall.
ex.zh: 水管工把漏水点追溯到隐藏在厨房墙壁后的一个接头。

ex.en: House prices plummeted in coastal towns after the government published new flood-risk maps covering thousands of properties.
ex.zh: 政府公布了涵盖数千处房产的新洪水风险地图后，沿海城镇的房价暴跌。

plunge.usage: plunge in/of... 投入/脱离……；近dive vi.跳水；dip v.浸。plunge into war陷入战争；prices plunge价格暴跌；索引p414

ex.en: Stock markets plunged at the news of the coup.
ex.zh: 政变的消息一传来，股票市场便暴跌。

ex.en: Temperatures plunged below freezing overnight, bursting water pipes across the city.
ex.zh: 一夜之间气温骤降到冰点以下，冻裂了全城的水管。

ex.en: The government warned that the country could plunge into a deep recession if the reforms failed.
ex.zh: 政府警告说，如果改革失败，国家可能陷入严重衰退。

ex.en: Some English nouns keep an old plural form, such as children and feet.
ex.zh: 一些英语名词保留着古老的复数形式，如 children 和 feet。

senses: adj. 正的,加的;(电)阳性的

ex.en: The apartment's low rent is a plus, though the noise from the road is a drawback.
ex.zh: 这套公寓租金低廉是个优势，不过公路上的噪音是个缺点。

ex.en: The complexity of modern supply chains makes it difficult for shoppers to trace where individual products actually come from.
ex.zh: 现代供应链的复杂性使购物者难以追溯单件产品的真实来源。

ex.en: Vaccination programmes have sharply reduced deaths from pneumonia among the elderly.
ex.zh: 疫苗接种计划大幅降低了老年人死于肺炎的人数。

senses: v. 煮,炖,煨;偷猎;盗用;挖走(人员等)
vt. 挖走(人员等)；盗用；水煮

ex.en: The company was accused of trying to poach senior engineers from its main rival.
ex.zh: 该公司被指控企图从其主要竞争对手那里挖走资深工程师。

senses: adj. 袖珍的,小型的; vt. 把……放入衣袋;占为己有;中饱私囊

ex.en: The subsidy eased the burden on the family pocket during the recession.
ex.zh: 衰退期间，这项补贴减轻了家庭开支的负担。

senses: n. 财政状况,财力,钱袋子;记事本,小笔记本;女用手提包

ex.en: For many voters, the issue that matters most is the pocketbook: wages, prices, and the cost of healthcare.
ex.zh: 对许多选民来说，最重要的是经济问题：工资、物价以及医疗费用。

ex.en: The poem captures the quiet beauty of life in the countryside.
ex.zh: 这首诗捕捉了乡村生活的宁静之美。

ex.en: She wrote her first poem at the age of ten.
ex.zh: 她十岁时写下了第一首诗。

ex.en: Each student was asked to recite a short poem from memory.
ex.zh: 每个学生都被要求凭记忆背诵一首短诗。

ex.en: The poet spent years traveling before settling in a coastal town.
ex.zh: 这位诗人在海滨小镇定居之前游历多年。

ex.en: Many critics regard him as the finest poet of his generation.
ex.zh: 许多评论家认为他是同代人中最出色的诗人。

ex.en: As a young poet she drew inspiration from the streets of her hometown.
ex.zh: 年轻时作为诗人，她从家乡的街道汲取灵感。

ex.en: Modern poetry often breaks the traditional rules of rhythm and rhyme.
ex.zh: 现代诗歌常常打破传统的节奏与韵律规则。

ex.en: Since retiring he has published several volumes of poetry.
ex.zh: 退休以来，他已出版了数卷诗集。

ex.en: Reading poetry aloud helps students appreciate the music of the language.
ex.zh: 朗读诗歌有助于学生领略语言的韵律之美。

ex.en: The reviewer's main point was that the study ignored regional differences.
ex.zh: 审稿人的主要观点是该研究忽视了地区差异。

senses: adj. 无意义的,无目标的;不值得做的

ex.en: Critics called the consultation pointless, arguing that the decision had already been made before residents were asked.
ex.zh: 批评者称这次征询毫无意义，指出在征求居民意见之前决定就已经作出了。

poison.usage: 因为给人下毒（poison），他被判入狱（prison）

ex.en: These mushrooms contain a deadly poison.
ex.zh: 这些蘑菇含有剧毒。

ex.en: Chemicals from the factory poisoned the river and killed thousands of fish.
ex.zh: 工厂的化学品毒害了河流，毒死数以千计的鱼。

ex.en: He was accused of trying to poison his business partner.
ex.zh: 他被控企图毒害自己的生意伙伴。

senses: adj. 恶毒的,邪恶的,讨厌的
adj. 有毒的；引起中毒的

ex.en: This gas is highly poisonous.
ex.zh: 这种气体有剧毒。

ex.en: Children should be taught never to touch mushrooms, since some poisonous kinds look harmless.
ex.zh: 应当教育孩子绝不要碰野生蘑菇，因为一些有毒的蘑菇看起来无害。

ex.en: The novel depicts a poisonous atmosphere of gossip and suspicion in the small village.
ex.zh: 这部小说描绘了小村庄里流言与猜忌的恶毒氛围。

poke.usage: 近stab vt.刺；jab vt.戳。poke fun at sb嘲笑；poke about/around翻找；索引p414

ex.en: He poked the fire with a stick to keep it burning.
ex.zh: 他用棍子拨了拨火，好让它继续烧着。

ex.en: The boy poked me in the arm and pointed at the puppy.
ex.zh: 男孩捅了捅我的胳膊，指着那只小狗。

ex.en: Green shoots were poking through the soil in early spring.
ex.zh: 早春时节，绿芽从土里探出头来。

books.unit: 附录 I 部分国家(或地区)名称及相关信息

ex.en: Poland's economy has grown steadily since it joined the European Union, attracting manufacturing investment from across Europe.
ex.zh: 自加入欧盟以来，波兰经济持续稳步增长，吸引了来自欧洲各地的制造业投资。

senses: a. 完全相反的；对立的
polar.usage: pol（轴）+-ar→绕轴两端的→极地的。polarity n.极性；对立；polarize v.使两极分化；派生polarity(磁体的)极性;polarize使有极性

ex.en: Satellite images show that polar ice is melting faster than models predicted.
ex.zh: 卫星图像显示，极地冰的融化速度快于模型预测。

ex.en: Scientists stationed at the pole measure changes in ice thickness throughout the year.
ex.zh: 驻守极地的科学家全年测量冰层厚度的变化。

ex.en: The police confirmed that the fire had been started deliberately, but no arrests have been made.
ex.zh: 警方证实火灾系人为纵火，但目前尚无人被捕。

ex.en: The policeman directed traffic for hours after the signals failed during the evening rush.
ex.zh: 傍晚交通高峰时段信号灯失灵后，这名警察连续指挥了数小时交通。

ex.en: Recruitment campaigns now encourage both policemen and policewomen to specialise in investigating cybercrime.
ex.zh: 招募宣传现在鼓励男女警察都去专攻网络犯罪调查。

ex.en: As the first policewoman in her district, she spent years proving that community policing benefits from diverse officers.
ex.zh: 作为所在警区的第一名女警察，她花了多年时间证明社区警务会因警员的多样性而受益。

senses: n. 政策，方针；原则；保险单
policy.usage: [族] policymaker n. 政策制定者；发音类似"魄力才"→制定大政"方针"是需要魄力的→方针；索引p414

ex.en: For a long time, scientists and policy makers concentrated on the idea that teenagers were a problem needed to be solved.
ex.zh: 很长一段时间以来，科学家和政策制定者都认为青少年是一个需要解决的问题。

ex.en: The government's new education policy aims to reduce the burden on students.
ex.zh: 政府的新教育政策旨在减轻学生的负担。

ex.en: Policymakers underestimated how quickly remote working would spread, according to documents released this week.
ex.zh: 根据本周公布的文件，政策制定者低估了远程办公普及的速度。

ex.en: Evidence-based policymaking requires reliable data, yet many departments still rely on outdated statistics.
ex.zh: 循证决策需要可靠的数据，然而许多部门仍在依赖过时的统计资料。

polish.usage: polish up one's English 温习英语；[族] polished a. 磨光的；[近] shine vt. 擦光；擦亮；polish中的po发音似“抛（光）”，抛光就是“擦亮，磨光”。

ex.en: The final, polished work that he gave to the world was the result of years of practising, re-practising, re-writing and reading.
ex.zh: 最终他留给世界的作品是经过精雕细琢的，是多年来练习、重写和阅读的结果。

ex.en: He polished the silver until every piece shone.
ex.zh: 他把银器擦得件件发亮。

ex.en: Take a little time to polish your essay before handing it in.
ex.zh: 交作业前花点时间把文章润色一下。

ex.en: Cosmopolitan cities attract talent precisely because they mix cultures, economies, and ideas.
ex.zh: 国际化大都市之所以能吸引人才，正是因为它们融合了不同的文化、经济与思想。

senses: a. 有礼貌的；客气的；应酬的；礼节性的

ex.en: Being polite to customers is not enough; staff must also resolve complaints quickly.
ex.zh: 对顾客有礼貌还不够，员工还必须迅速解决投诉。

political.usage: [族] politician n. 政治家；政客；adj.政治的，政府的；政党的； 关心政治的，参与政治的；索引p414

ex.en: great social and political changes
ex.zh: 巨大的社会变化和政治变革

ex.en: The scandal quickly became a political crisis that threatened the prime minister's position.
ex.zh: 丑闻很快演变成一场威胁首相地位的政治危机。

ex.en: Corruption remains one of the most serious political problems in many developing countries.
ex.zh: 腐败仍是许多发展中国家最严重的政治问题之一。

ex.en: The reform is politically sensitive because it would raise taxes for millions of middle-income households.
ex.zh: 这项改革在政治上很敏感，因为它将提高数百万中等收入家庭的税收。

politician.usage: n.政客、政治家；n.从政者，政治家；政客，善 于玩弄权术者；索引p414

ex.en: Voters increasingly complain that no politician seems willing to tackle the housing shortage.
ex.zh: 选民日益抱怨，似乎没有一位政治家愿意解决住房短缺问题。

ex.en: A skillful politician knows when to compromise and when to stand firm.
ex.zh: 老练的政治家懂得何时妥协、何时坚持。

ex.en: The young politician promised to reform the outdated voting system if elected.
ex.zh: 这位年轻的政治人物承诺，如果当选就改革过时的投票制度。

politics.usage: [族] politically ad. 政治上；n.政治学；n.政治；政治学；政治信仰， 政治观点；索引p414

ex.en: This kind of thinking is why so many people try to avoid arguments, especially about politics and religion.
ex.zh: 这种想法就是很多人竭力避免争论，尤其是关于政治和宗教的争论的原因。

ex.en: She studied politics at university before joining a think tank in London.
ex.zh: 她在大学学习政治学，之后加入伦敦一家智库。

ex.en: Office politics can be as decisive for a career as professional competence.
ex.zh: 职场内的权力之争对职业生涯的影响可能与专业能力同样关键。

senses: n. 投票,投票结果;(pl.)政治选举,大选
v. 对…进行民意测验;获得(选票)

ex.en: A recent poll suggests that most voters support stricter controls on advertising aimed at children.
ex.zh: 最近一项民调显示，多数选民支持对面向儿童的广告实施更严格的管控。

ex.en: Stricter limits on industrial pollutants have measurably improved air quality in the region over the past decade.
ex.zh: 对工业污染物更严格的限制使该地区的空气质量在过去十年有了可测量的改善。

pollute.usage: [族] pollution n. 污染；pollutant n. 污染物；[族] pollution n. 污染；派生pollutant污染物质

ex.en: Madrid was hailed as a public health beacon last November when it rolled out ambitious restrictions on the most polluting cars.
ex.zh: 去年11月，马德里针对污染最严重的汽车推出了耗时巨大的管控措施，因此被誉为公共卫生健康的灯塔。

ex.en: Factories that pollute the river will face heavy fines under the new law.
ex.zh: 依照新法律，污染河流的工厂将面临巨额罚款。

ex.en: Residents fear that the new plant will pollute the air for miles around.
ex.zh: 居民担心新工厂会污染周围数英里的空气。

ex.en: Air pollution in big cities is closely linked to breathing diseases.
ex.zh: 大城市的空气污染与呼吸系统疾病密切相关。

ex.en: The government has promised to halve pollution from vehicles within ten years.
ex.zh: 政府承诺在十年内将机动车污染减半。

ex.en: Noise pollution near airports has become a growing source of complaints.
ex.zh: 机场附近的噪音污染日益成为民众抱怨的来源。

ex.en: The new polytechnic trains technicians who can maintain the robots now common on factory floors.
ex.zh: 这所新理工学院培养的技术人员能够维护如今工厂车间里常见的机器人。

ex.en: Because polymers can be moulded at low temperatures, manufacturers use them to replace metal parts in cars and aircraft.
ex.zh: 由于聚合物可以在较低温度下成型，制造商用它们来替代汽车和飞机上的金属部件。

ex.en: The match was postponed until Thursday because of the severe weather warning issued by the local meteorological office.
ex.zh: 由于当地气象部门发布恶劣天气预警，比赛被推迟到周四举行。

ex.en: Frogs return to the same pond each spring to breed, guided by chemical cues in the water.
ex.zh: 每年春天青蛙凭借水中的化学信号回到同一池塘繁殖。

senses: v. 沉思,考虑;衡量,估量;回想,回顾
ponder.usage: 发音类似"胖的"→胖的人经常考虑怎么减肥→考虑

ex.en: Intelligence seeks to grasp, manipulate, reorder, and adjust, while intellect examines, ponders, wonders, theorizes, criticizes, and imagines.
ex.zh: 智力寻求的是理解、运用、整合和调节，而才智是审视、思考、琢磨、形成理论、批判和想象。

ex.en: She sat by the window, pondering whether to accept the offer.
ex.zh: 她坐在窗边，暗自思量是否接受那份邀请。

ex.en: The committee will ponder the proposal before giving its final answer.
ex.zh: 委员会将先仔细斟酌该提案，再给出最终答复。

senses: adj. 慢条斯理的；沉闷乏味的；缓慢的；笨拙的

ex.en: She watched the ponderous progress of her old father.
ex.zh: 她看着老父亲缓慢地往前走着。

ex.en: The children's farm keeps two Shetland ponies whose small size makes them ideal for teaching young riders.
ex.zh: 这家儿童农场养着两匹设特兰矮种马，它们体型娇小，非常适合用来教儿童骑马。

senses: n. 一滩,一片;联营,联合投资
pool.usage: pool one's ideas 集思广益

ex.en: The universities agreed to pool their laboratory resources to cut costs.
ex.zh: 几所大学同意共享实验室资源以削减开支。

poor.usage: the poor 表一类人，谓语用复数

ex.en: The study links poor sleep directly to reduced concentration at work.
ex.zh: 该研究将糟糕的睡眠与工作时注意力下降直接联系起来。

senses: vi. 突然出现；突然来到
n. 现代流行风格(尤指音乐的);(发出)砰的一声
adj. 通俗的;流行的;民众的
pop.usage: [族] popular a. 流行的；又:pop sth. into sth.将某物很快放于某处;pop over/across to突然造访

ex.en: Streaming has changed how pop music reaches its audience, bypassing traditional radio.
ex.zh: 流媒体改变了流行音乐触达听众的方式，绕过了传统电台。

ex.en: The pope appealed for calm after the disputed election results were announced.
ex.zh: 在有争议的选举结果公布后，教皇呼吁各方保持冷静。

senses: adj. 流行的,通俗的,大众的
adj. 广受欢迎的;有名的
adj. 受欢迎的；流行的；普遍的；百姓的
popular.usage: [族] popularity n. 普及；流行；索引p414

ex.en: Cycling has become increasingly popular among young office workers.
ex.zh: 骑自行车在年轻上班族中越来越流行。

ex.en: The museum is especially popular with families during school holidays.
ex.zh: 学校放假期间，这家博物馆尤其受家庭游客欢迎。

ex.en: The magazine explains science in popular language for ordinary readers.
ex.zh: 这份杂志用通俗的语言向普通读者讲解科学。

ex.en: It was popularized as a marketing trick by clothing manufacturers in the 1930s.
ex.zh: 它作为一种营销手段，在20世纪30年代因服装生产商而得以普及。

ex.en: Documentary films have helped popularise science among audiences who might never open a textbook.
ex.zh: 纪录片帮助科学在那些可能永远不会翻开教科书的观众中得到普及。

ex.en: The popularity of electric cars is forcing oil companies to rethink long-term investment.
ex.zh: 电动汽车的流行正迫使石油公司重新思考长期投资。

popularize.usage: v.宣传，推广；使普及，使通 俗化

ex.en: Museums now use interactive displays to popularize history, drawing visitors who once found galleries intimidating.
ex.zh: 博物馆如今利用互动展览来普及历史，吸引了那些曾对展厅望而却步的参观者。

ex.en: Early settlers began to populate the valley once the irrigation canals were completed.
ex.zh: 灌溉渠修成后，早期移民开始在这条山谷聚居。

senses: n. [C]（某地域或群体的）全体居民
population.usage: population 作主语时谓语可用单/复数；n.人口；某领域的生物，族群

ex.en: The country's population is aging faster than ever before in its history.
ex.zh: 该国人口老龄化的速度超过了历史上任何时期。

ex.en: Nearly half of the world's population now lives in urban areas.
ex.zh: 如今全世界近一半的人口居住在城市。

ex.en: The tiger population in the reserve has doubled since stricter protection began.
ex.zh: 自加强保护以来，保护区内的老虎数量翻了一番。

senses: a. 人口众多的；人口密集的
adj. 人口众多的,人口稠密的

ex.en: Asia contains several of the world's most populous cities, placing huge pressure on housing.
ex.zh: 亚洲拥有世界上若干人口最多的城市，给住房带来巨大压力。

ex.en: Officials plan to transport the recovered manuscripts to a climate-controlled archive for careful restoration.
ex.zh: 官员们计划把这些找回的手稿运往恒温恒湿的档案馆进行细致修复。

ex.en: Chinese porcelain was once so prized in Europe that it was known as white gold.
ex.zh: 中国瓷器曾在欧洲备受珍视，甚至被称为白色黄金。

ex.en: The old man sat on the porch every evening, watching the street slowly empty.
ex.zh: 老人每晚坐在门廊上，看着街道渐渐冷清下来。

ex.en: Lawyers spent weeks poring over the contract, searching for clauses that might expose their client to unexpected liabilities.
ex.zh: 律师们花了数周时间仔细审阅合同，寻找可能使其客户承担意外责任的条款。

ex.en: Health guidelines advise cooking pork thoroughly to avoid parasitic infection.
ex.zh: 健康指南建议将猪肉彻底煮熟以避免寄生虫感染。

ex.en: The port handles most of the country's container traffic, making it a strategic asset.
ex.zh: 该港口承担了全国大部分集装箱运输，因而具有战略意义。

senses: adj. 便于携带的,手提的,轻便的
portable.usage: 助记:port(拿,带,运)+able(形容词后缀)→能方便拿的→便于携带的；port（拿，运）+able（能……的）→能拿的→便携式的；轻便的。拓展：a portable TV 手提电视机。；索引p414

ex.en: The new portable projector fits into a bag and works for five hours on one charge.
ex.zh: 新型便携投影仪能装进包里，一次充电可工作五小时。

ex.en: Portable music players changed how and where people choose to listen to recordings.
ex.zh: 便携音乐播放器改变了人们收听录音的方式和场合。

ex.en: Doctors carried portable equipment to the villages that had no road access.
ex.zh: 医生们携带便携设备前往不通公路的村庄。

porter.usage: 助记:port(拿,带,运)+er(名词后缀表示人)→运货物的人→搬运工人

ex.en: The hotel porter carried the luggage to the room and explained the facilities.
ex.zh: 酒店行李员把行李送到房间并讲解了各项设施。

senses: n. 文件夹,公事包;作品,整套照片;投资组合
n. (部长或大臣的)职责,职务
portfolio.usage: 助记:port(拿,带,运)+folio(书籍的一页)→能夹带一页页的东西→文件夹

ex.en: Financial advisers warn against putting an entire portfolio into a single industry.
ex.zh: 理财顾问警告不要把整个投资组合押在单一行业上。

senses: v. 把……分成若干份(或部分),分配
portion.usage: [近] part n. 部分；port（形似part“部分；分开”）+ion（表示名词）→部分。

ex.en: A large portion of the budget goes to staff salaries.
ex.zh: 预算的很大一部分用于员工薪酬。

ex.en: The restaurant is famous for the generous size of its portions.
ex.zh: 这家餐馆以分量十足而闻名。

ex.en: She divided the cake into eight equal portions.
ex.zh: 她把蛋糕分成八等份。

ex.en: The gallery's newest portrait of the writer was painted by a young local artist.
ex.zh: 美术馆最新收录的这位作家肖像出自一位当地年轻画家之手。

ex.en: Her biography offers a vivid portrait of life in the factory towns of the 1930s.
ex.zh: 她的传记生动描绘了 20 世纪 30 年代工厂城镇的生活。

ex.en: photographic portraits
ex.zh: 摄影肖像

portray.usage: 记：por-(向前)+tra(拉)+y→拉着牛向前走装扮成农夫→扮演；[族]portrayal n.描绘；[近]depict vt.描绘；por（向前）+tray（拉）→把形象拉到人前→描绘。族portrait n.肖像；portrayal n.描绘；派生portrayal画像,描绘;描述;扮演；por（发音类似pou

ex.en: The film portrays the scientist as a stubborn idealist rather than a cold technician.
ex.zh: 这部电影把这位科学家描绘成一个顽固的理想主义者，而非冷漠的技术人员。

ex.en: Critics say the report portrays the city's schools in an unfairly negative light.
ex.zh: 批评者说，该报告对城市学校的描绘有失公允、过于负面。

ex.en: portray landscape
ex.zh: 描绘风景

books.unit: 附录 I 部分国家(或地区)名称及相关信息

ex.en: Portugal has become a model for renewable energy, generating most of its electricity from wind and sunlight.
ex.zh: 葡萄牙已成为可再生能源的典范，其大部分电力来自风能和太阳能。

ex.en: The report questions the widely held position that economic growth automatically reduces poverty.
ex.zh: 该报告对经济增长必然能减少贫困这一广为接受的立场提出了质疑。

senses: vt. 造成（威胁、问题等）；引起
②提出(问题等)；陈述(论点等)；产生，引起

ex.en: Ryan Hooper remarks that significant moves may pose challenges to children.
ex.zh: 瑞恩·胡珀说，重大的变迁可能会给孩子们带来挑战。

ex.en: Rapid urbanization poses a serious threat to farmland and water supplies.
ex.zh: 快速城市化对农田和水资源构成严重威胁。

ex.en: The children posed for a photograph in front of the newly painted mural.
ex.zh: 孩子们在新画的壁画前摆好姿势拍照。

senses: ②地位，身份，等级(c/u)；③职位，职务(c)
④姿势，姿态；⑤见解，立场，态度(c)；⑥处境，状况，形势(c)

phrases.p: in a position to/in no position to

position.usage: [近] location n. 位置；[近] standpoint n. 立场；n.位置，地点；姿势；处 境，状况；观点，立场； 地位；职位 v.安置；词根记忆：pos(put,放)+ition(表行为、动作)→放置→位置；②观点(2021新题型)：Having asserted your position, demo

ex.en: Now we can understand each other's positions and recognize our shared values, since we both care about needy workers.
ex.zh: 现在我们可以理解彼此的立场，认识到我们共同的价值，因为我们都关心贫困工人。

ex.en: The author believes that the bills sponsored by Lewis and Haddad will raise women's position in politics.
ex.zh: 作者认为，刘易斯和哈达德提交的议案将提高女性的政治地位。

ex.en: The map shows the exact position of the new hospital relative to the main road.
ex.zh: 地图标出了新医院相对于主干道的准确位置。

senses: adj. ①积极乐观的，自信的
②确实的，明确的，肯定的；③积极的，建设性的
④十足的，完全的；⑤正的，阳性的
positive.usage: [反] negative a. 消极的；pos(=pose摆放)+i+tive(形容词后缀)→愿意把姿态摆放出来去做一件事，就是"积极乐观的"；词根:posit(put放)+ive(形容词后缀)→可以放下的→积极的；索引p414

ex.en: Overseas investment has had a positive effect on exports.
ex.zh: 海外投资对出口有积极影响。

ex.en: A positive attitude towards difficulties helps people overcome setbacks.
ex.zh: 对困难持积极态度有助于人们克服挫折。

senses: adv. 积极地；肯定地；绝对地
positively.usage: adv.绝对地；乐观地；赞成地； 明确地；带正电地；索引p414

ex.en: Participants responded positively to the new schedule, reporting less stress and better sleep.
ex.zh: 参与者对新时间安排反应积极，表示压力减小、睡眠改善。

ex.en: The museum possesses one of the finest collections of Ming porcelain outside China.
ex.zh: 该博物馆收藏有中国以外最精美的明代瓷器藏品之一。

senses: vt. 拥有(某物)；具有(某种品质或才能)；支配，控制
possess.usage: [族] possession n. 拥有；财产；派生possession n.拥有，个人财产；词根记忆：pos(having power,有权力)+sess(sit,坐)→有权坐在宝座上→拥有。；索引p414

ex.en: As late as 1969 a third of American professors did not possess a doctoral degree.
ex.zh: 直到1969年，三分之一的美国教授没有获得博士学位。

ex.en: Successful teams possess a clear sense of purpose that carries them through setbacks.
ex.zh: 成功的团队拥有一种帮助其渡过挫折的明确使命感。

ex.en: possess no immense wealth
ex.zh: 并无巨额财富

possession.usage: n.拥有，持有；个人财产，所有 物；索引p414

ex.en: But this distinction misses the point that it is processing and aggregation, not the mere possession of bits, that gives the data value.
ex.zh: 但是这种区分遗漏了一点：可以使数据产生价值的是处理与整合，而不仅仅是占有。

ex.en: The police found stolen goods in the driver's possession.
ex.zh: 警方在司机身上查获了被盗财物。

senses: n. 可能的事,希望;机会,契机
possibility.usage: [族] possible a. 可能的；反义: impossibility；索引p414

ex.en: Enjoy the beauty of the world around and keep the eyes open to see the possibilities before you.
ex.zh: 享受周围世界的美好，抓住眼前的机会。

ex.en: There is a real possibility that the flight will be delayed by the storm.
ex.zh: 航班很有可能因暴风雨而延误。

ex.en: Scientists continue to explore the possibility of life on other planets.
ex.zh: 科学家们仍在探索其他行星上存在生命的可能性。

senses: adj. 可能的,做得到的,潜在的,可能发生的
adj. 可以接受的,合适的,合理的
n. 合适的人(或物),可能出现的事物
adj. 可能存在（或发生）的

ex.en: Please reply as soon as possible so that we can confirm the booking.
ex.zh: 请尽快回复，以便我们确认预订。

ex.en: It is possible to finish the work on time if everyone cooperates.
ex.zh: 只要大家合作，按时完成这项工作是可能的。

ex.en: The doctors did everything humanly possible to save the patient.
ex.zh: 医生们竭尽全力抢救病人。

ex.en: The committee could not possibly review every application in detail, so it relied on a preliminary screening system.
ex.zh: 委员会不可能详细审查每一份申请，因此依赖一套初步筛选系统。

senses: v. 贴出;宣布,公告;投寄,邮寄
n. (支)柱,标杆;起点或终点标志

ex.en: She was appointed to the post of chief editor after a decade in the newsroom.
ex.zh: 在编辑部工作十年后，她被任命为主编一职。

ex.en: In remote villages the post office often serves as a bank, a shop, and the only public meeting place.
ex.zh: 在偏远的村庄，邮局常常身兼银行、商店，甚至是唯一的公共聚会场所。

postage.usage: [族] postal a. 邮政的；助记:post(邮寄)+age(名词后缀,表示性质)→邮费

ex.en: Rising postage costs pushed small publishers toward electronic distribution.
ex.zh: 邮资上涨促使小型出版商转向电子发行。

postal.usage: adj.邮政的，邮递的；adj.邮政的，邮递的 很多球星被draft 出来后，成为了celebrity,为了convince 公众他们的品行，他们会做很多 事情。For instance,去church，去serve 社区，去blame 经济的虚假boom,去帮助

ex.en: Postal workers in several cities have staged strikes demanding better protection against rising workplace violence.
ex.zh: 多个城市的邮政工人举行了罢工，要求加强对日益增多的职场暴力的防范。

ex.en: She sent a postcard from the coastal town, praising its seafood and quiet beaches.
ex.zh: 她从海滨小镇寄出一张明信片，称赞那里的海鲜和安静的海滩。

poster.usage: [近] advertisement n. 广告；助记:post(公告)+er(名词后缀,表示物)→广告

ex.en: A single poster on the underground doubled attendance at the small gallery.
ex.zh: 地铁里的一张海报使这家小美术馆的参观人数翻了一番。

ex.en: The novelist donated her letters to the national library so that they would be preserved for posterity.
ex.zh: 这位小说家把她的书信捐赠给国家图书馆，以便为后世妥善保存。

ex.en: When the new staff predominantly young men and women fresh from postgraduate study, they largely define the norms of academic life in that faculty.
ex.zh: 当新员工主要是刚从研究生院毕业的年轻男女时，他们在很大程度上决定了该学院的学术生活规范。

ex.en: She is reading for a postgraduate degree in economics.
ex.zh: 她正在攻读经济学研究生学位。

ex.en: The department offers generous scholarships to outstanding postgraduates.
ex.zh: 该系向优秀研究生提供丰厚的奖学金。

ex.en: In the age of email, the postman's daily round remains a lifeline for elderly people living alone.
ex.zh: 在电子邮件时代，邮递员的每日投递对独居老人来说仍然是一条生命线。

ex.en: Novels and films still romanticise the mailman who brings unexpected letters that change ordinary lives.
ex.zh: 小说和电影仍在浪漫化邮递员的形象——他送来的不期而至的信件改变了平凡的生活。

senses: adj. 后现代的；后现代主义的

ex.en: Architects abandoned strict functionalism in the 1980s, embracing postmodern designs that mixed historical styles with irony.
ex.zh: 二十世纪八十年代，建筑师们摒弃了严格的功能主义，转而拥抱将历史风格与戏谑手法相混合的后现代设计。

postpone.usage: [近] delay vt. 延误；[族] postponement n. 延期；[近] delay vt.&vi. 推迟，延期（做某事）；助记:post(前缀,后)+pone(put放置)→往后放→延迟；post（表示“后”）+pon（表示“放置”）+e→往后放置，意味着“延迟”。；索引p414

ex.en: The game has already been postponed three times.
ex.zh: 这场比赛已经三度延期了。

ex.en: The committee voted to postpone the decision until more complete data were available.
ex.zh: 委员会投票决定，待获得更完整的数据后再作决定。

ex.en: Rising debts forced the city to postpone several long-planned infrastructure projects.
ex.zh: 债务攀升迫使该市推迟了几个酝酿已久的基础设施项目。

postulate.usage: postul（要求）+ate→作为要求提出→假定。近义：assume vt. 假定；postul（要求）+-ate→作为前提提出→假定。近assume vt.假定；hypothesis n.假设

ex.en: Economists often postulate that individuals act rationally, an assumption behavioural research has repeatedly challenged.
ex.zh: 经济学家常常假定个人行为是理性的，而行为科学研究一再挑战这一假设。

senses: n. 态度,看法;心情,心境
n. 姿势；立场；态度；情形
posture.usage: [族] posturing n. 做作的举止；忸怩作态；[近] position n. 姿势；pose"摆放，摆姿势"的名词

ex.en: Good posture is essential when working at the computer.
ex.zh: 用电脑工作时良好的姿势极其重要。

ex.en: The government has adopted a firmer posture in the trade talks.
ex.zh: 政府在贸易谈判中采取了更为强硬的立场。

ex.en: Sitting in the same posture for hours can harm your spine.
ex.zh: 长时间保持同一坐姿会损害脊柱。

ex.en: The archaeologist lifted the lid of the ancient pot and found grains still inside.
ex.zh: 考古学家揭开古陶罐的盖子，发现里面还留着谷物。

senses: n. 钾碱,草碱(一种从木炭灰中提取的白色粉状物质,有时用作肥料)

ex.en: Global demand for potash fertiliser has risen as farmers seek higher yields from limited arable land.
ex.zh: 随着农民力求从有限的耕地中获得更高产量，全球对钾肥的需求不断上升。

ex.en: Sweet potatoes, originally native to Central America, became a staple food across Europe within a century of their introduction.
ex.zh: 红薯原产于中美洲，引入后不到一个世纪便成为欧洲各地的主食。

senses: a. 强有力的；有效力的
potent.usage: pot（能力）+-ent→有能力的→强有力的。族potential a.潜在的 n.潜力；potency n.效力

ex.en: The vaccine proved potent against the new variant in early trials, though larger studies are still needed.
ex.zh: 在早期试验中，这种疫苗对新的变异毒株显示出强劲的效力，不过仍需更大规模的研究。

senses: n. 潜在性;可能性;潜力,潜能
n. 潜质，潜力；可能性，潜在性
potential.usage: [近] possible a. 可能的；latent a. 潜在的；辨析: potential 强调能明显发现的积极潜力,多用于褒义; implicit 未用语言表达但可由迹象推断; latent 以前明显现在隐藏、不活跃；adj.潜在的，可能的 n.潜力，可能性；潜能；词根：pot(capable of有能力的)+e

ex.en: Asking them questions about what they like about the backyard of a potential home will make them feel like they're being included in the decision-making process.
ex.zh: 向他们询问喜欢未来住宅后院的哪些方面，会让他们觉得自己也参与了决策过程。

ex.en: The potential of this work applied to healthcare is very great, but it could also lead to further concentration of power in the tech giants.
ex.zh: 这一工作成果（指AI技术成果）应用于医疗行业的潜力巨大，但它也有可能导致科技巨头的势力进一步集中。

ex.en: The new drug shows great potential for treating heart disease.
ex.zh: 这种新药在治疗心脏病方面显示出巨大潜力。

phrases.m: 潜在对抗性更小的保护措施

ex.en: The leak was potentially catastrophic, but quick action by engineers prevented any contamination of drinking water.
ex.zh: 这次泄漏本可能酿成灾难，但工程师们的迅速行动防止了饮用水受到任何污染。

senses: n. 陶器;陶土;制陶技艺
n. 制陶作坊;陶窑;陶器工厂

ex.en: Fragments of pottery unearthed at the site suggest that the ancient settlement traded extensively with neighbouring villages.
ex.zh: 遗址出土的陶器碎片表明，这个古代定居点曾与邻近村庄进行大量贸易。

senses: n. [U] 家禽；（商店里的）禽肉
poultry.usage: poult（小鸡）+-ry→家禽统称。chicken鸡/duck鸭/turkey火鸡均属poultry

ex.en: Rising demand for poultry has pushed farmers to adopt intensive production methods that critics say harm animal welfare.
ex.zh: 对禽肉需求的上升促使养殖户采用集约化生产方式，批评者称这种方式损害动物福利。

senses: v. (连续)猛击,(猛烈)敲打,捣碎

phrases.m: 合法但有失人情的要求

pound.usage: pound away at 连续攻击；助记:他bound(跳跃)时round(圆形的)pound(英镑)掉了出来

ex.en: The pound fell sharply against the dollar after the central bank signalled that interest rates would remain unchanged.
ex.zh: 央行暗示利率将维持不变后，英镑对美元汇率大幅下跌。

phrases.p: It never rains but it pours.

ex.en: Billions of dollars have been poured into renewable energy research over the past decade.
ex.zh: 过去十年间，数百亿美元被投入可再生能源研究。

poverty.usage: [反] wealth n. 财富；[反]wealth n. 财富；拓展：alleviate poverty 缩小贫困；索引p414

ex.en: The country offers wealth for a few in the great cities and poverty for the remaining tribal peoples.
ex.zh: 这个国家为大城市里的少数人提供了财富，而留给其余各部落民族的都是贫困。

ex.en: Millions of children still live in poverty in some developing countries.
ex.zh: 在一些发展中国家，仍有数百万儿童生活在贫困之中。

ex.en: The failure of the harvest plunged the family into deeper poverty.
ex.zh: 收成的歉收使这个家庭陷入更深的贫困。

ex.en: Museum conservators used a fine powder to absorb moisture from the ancient manuscripts before restoring them.
ex.zh: 博物馆修复人员在修复前用细粉末吸收古代手稿中的水分。

power.usage: [族] powerful a. 强大的；真题搭配：power of enforcement 执行权；new power sources 新能源；power failures 供电故障；have the power to do that 有那样做的能力；索引p414

ex.en: In Scotland, for example, wind turbines provide enough electricity to power 95 percent of homes.
ex.zh: 比如在苏格兰，风力发电机所生产的电足以满足95%的家庭用电需求。

ex.en: The president used her power to veto the bill passed by Congress.
ex.zh: 总统动用权力否决了国会通过的法案。

ex.en: Reading gives us the power to imagine lives very different from our own.
ex.zh: 阅读赋予我们想象与自己截然不同的生活的力量。

senses: a. 强有力的；有影响力的；效力大的；强壮的
adj. 强大的,有力的,有权的
adj. 有权力的，有权势的；强大的，有影响力的
adj. 强有力的；有影响力的；强烈的；效力强大的；强壮的

phrases.p: the powerful influence of American culture
phrases.m: 美国文化的强大影响力

powerful.usage: adj.强大的，权力大的，（药） 有效的；索引p414

ex.en: But Mauna Kea is also home to some of the world's most powerful telescopes.
ex.zh: 但英纳克亚山也是世界上一些最强大望远镜的坐落之地。

ex.en: The internet has become a powerful tool for spreading information.
ex.zh: 互联网已成为传播信息的强大工具。

ex.en: He gave a powerful speech that moved the entire audience.
ex.zh: 他发表了一场打动全场听众的有力演讲。

senses: adv. 有影响力地,强有力地

ex.en: The film argues powerfully that economic growth alone cannot guarantee improvements in public health.
ex.zh: 这部影片有力地论证了单靠经济增长无法保证公共健康的改善。

senses: n. 强大的集团(或组织)

ex.en: Once reliant on heavy industry, the region has become a powerhouse of renewable-energy manufacturing.
ex.zh: 该地区曾依赖重工业，如今已成为可再生能源制造业的强大基地。

senses: adj. 无影响力的,无权的,无能为力的
powerless.usage: adj.无力的；无能力的，无权的

ex.en: Local councils feel powerless to tackle congestion because transport policy is decided entirely at the national level.
ex.zh: 地方议会在治理拥堵方面感到无能为力，因为交通政策完全由国家层面决定。

ex.en: The engineering course requires students to complete a practical project before they graduate.
ex.zh: 这门工程学课程要求学生在毕业前完成一个实践项目。

senses: adj. 实际的；实践性的；客观存在的；适用的
practical.usage: [反] theoretical a. 理论的；practical 意为实用的、实际的、有实际经验的；practicable 指(计划、主意等)能实行的、可行的；adj.实际的；切实可行的；务实 的 n.实践课；practical knowledge实践知识；索引p414

ex.en: The training course gives students practical experience in dealing with real customers.
ex.zh: 培训课程让学生获得应对真实客户的实践经验。

ex.en: His plan is ingenious in theory but far from practical given the limited budget.
ex.zh: 他的方案在理论上很精巧，但考虑到预算有限并不切实可行。

ex.en: For practical reasons, the meeting has been moved from the capital to an online platform.
ex.zh: 出于实际原因，会议已从首都移至线上平台举行。

senses: n. 可行性,适用性;实事求是

ex.en: Critics praised the design's elegance but questioned its practicality in regions with limited access to electricity.
ex.zh: 批评者赞赏该设计的美观，但质疑其在电力供应有限地区的实用性。

senses: adv. 实际上；几乎，差不多
practically.usage: adv.几乎，差不多；实际上；索引p414

ex.en: Practically every week features at least one celebrity mom, or mom-to-be, smiling on the newsstands.
ex.zh: 几乎每周都至少有一位明星妈妈或准妈妈微笑着出现在报摊上。

ex.en: The two languages are practically identical in everyday speech.
ex.zh: 这两种语言在日常口语中几乎一模一样。

ex.en: Practically speaking, the project will cost far more than the town can afford.
ex.zh: 实际上，这项工程的花费将远远超出该镇的承受能力。

practice.usage: practise v. 练习（美式拼写）；亦作 practise；②n.惯例2017年阅读：laws, policies, and practices；common practice惯例；习惯做法；索引p414

ex.en: And the stock market reacts positively when companies tie CEO pay to, say, stock prices, a sign that those practices build up corporate value not just for the CEO.
ex.zh: 而且，当公司将首席执行官的薪酬，比如说与股价挂钩时，股票市场反映良好，这表明那些做法能够增加企业价值，而不只是为了首席执行官个人。

ex.en: Exchanging business cards with both hands is common practice in Japan.
ex.zh: 在日本，双手递接名片是常见的礼节。

ex.en: She practices the piano for an hour every evening.
ex.zh: 她每天晚上练一小时钢琴。

senses: v. ①实践，实行，实习，训练
③从事(医务、法律等工作)，执业

ex.en: She qualified as a doctor in 2010 and has practised medicine in rural clinics ever since.
ex.zh: 她于2010年取得医生资格，此后一直在乡村诊所行医。

practitioner.usage: n.从业人员，执业者；实践者

ex.en: Every medical practitioner must hold a valid license to treat patients.
ex.zh: 每位执业医生都必须持有有效执照才能诊治病人。

ex.en: The training course is open to practitioners from all fields of education.
ex.zh: 这门培训课程向各教育领域的从业者开放。

ex.en: Experienced practitioners often develop their own techniques over the years.
ex.zh: 经验丰富的从业者在多年实践中往往形成自己的技法。

ex.en: Vast prairies once supported enormous herds of bison, whose grazing patterns shaped the ecology of North America.
ex.zh: 广袤的大草原曾供养着庞大的野牛群，其啃食模式塑造了北美的生态。

senses: n. 称赞,赞美,赞美的话
praise.usage: [反] criticize vt. 批评；praise sb. for sth.因某事而赞扬某人;with high praise受到高度赞扬；摔跤比赛中你打倒对手，对手趴(p)在地上，举起(raise)大拇指，就是在“表扬”你

ex.en: Retail trade groups praised the ruling.
ex.zh: 零售贸易组织对这一裁决表示赞赏。

ex.en: The teacher praised the students for their imaginative solution to the problem.
ex.zh: 老师称赞学生们对这个问题提出了富有想象力的解决办法。

ex.en: Her debut novel has won high praise from the critics.
ex.zh: 她的处女作小说赢得了评论家的高度赞誉。

pray.usage: [族] prayer n. 祈祷；pray to sb. for...祈求...;be past praying for病入膏肓;助记:pray(恳求)放了prey(猎物)；哪怕只有一线(ray)希望，他们也会祈祷(pray)；索引p414

ex.en: They knelt down and prayed.
ex.zh: 他们跪下来祷告。

ex.en: The families gathered at the church to pray for the missing fishermen.
ex.zh: 家属们聚集在教堂为失踪的渔民祈祷。

ex.en: We can only pray that the rescue team arrives before the storm strengthens.
ex.zh: 我们只能祈求救援队在风暴增强前赶到。

ex.en: The villagers gathered at the temple to offer prayers for a good harvest.
ex.zh: 村民们聚集在庙里祈求丰收。

ex.en: She says a quiet prayer every night before going to sleep.
ex.zh: 她每晚睡前都默默祈祷。

ex.en: For many people, prayer is a source of comfort in hard times.
ex.zh: 对许多人而言，祈祷是艰难时刻的慰藉。

ex.en: Trade figures released by the PRC show that exports to Southeast Asian countries rose sharply last quarter.
ex.zh: 中华人民共和国公布的贸易数据显示，上一季度对东南亚国家的出口大幅增长。

ex.en: Scientists can now predict floods several days in advance, giving communities time to evacuate safely.
ex.zh: 科学家现在可以提前数日预测洪水，让社区有时间为安全撤离做好准备。

preach.usage: pr-（前）+each→站在人前宣讲→布道。近advocate vt.提倡；sermon n.布道；索引p414

ex.en: The priest preached to a large congregation on Sunday morning.
ex.zh: 周日上午，牧师向众多会众布道。

ex.en: He never stops preaching the virtues of thrift, though he spends freely himself.
ex.zh: 他不停地宣扬节俭的美德，尽管自己花钱大手大脚。

ex.en: Business schools are often accused of preaching theories far removed from real management.
ex.zh: 商学院常被指责宣扬的理论与实际管理相去甚远。

senses: n. [C-常用pl.] 预防措施；预防
n. 预防，警惕；预防措施(c)
precaution.usage: 记：pre-（前）+caut（小心）+-ion（名词后缀）→提前做出的举动→预防措施；pre（提前）+caution（小心）→做事前就小心→预防措施。

ex.en: You must take all reasonable precautions to protect yourself and your family.
ex.zh: 你必须采取一切合理的预防措施，保护自己和家人。

ex.en: As a precaution, the airline canceled all flights ahead of the storm.
ex.zh: 作为预防措施，航空公司在暴风雨来临前取消了所有航班。

ex.en: Take the usual precautions when carrying large amounts of cash.
ex.zh: 携带大量现金时要采取平日常用的防范措施。

ex.en: On the basis of the precautionary principle, it could be argued that it is advisable to follow the FSA advice.
ex.zh: 基于预防为主的原则，可以说听从食品标准局(FSA)的建议才是明智之举。

senses: v. 在……之前发生（或出现），先于
vt. 在…之前发生或存在；走在…之前
precede.usage: pre（在前的）+cede（走）→走在前面→先于；索引p414

ex.en: Federal laws precede state laws.
ex.zh: 联邦法律高于州法律。

ex.en: Although sadness also precedes tears, evidence suggests that emotions can flow from muscular responses.
ex.zh: 虽然悲伤情绪也会在流泪之前出现，但有证据显示，情绪可以来自肌肉反应。

ex.en: A short welcome speech preceded the award ceremony.
ex.zh: 颁奖典礼之前有一段简短的致辞。

senses: adj. 在前的，在先的，优先的
n. 先例；范例；传统；常规

ex.en: Legal scholars say that Vermont case will offer a precedent-setting test of how far those powers extend.
ex.zh: 法律学者说，佛蒙特州案件将会提供一个先例，用于检验“州政府的权力究竟有多大”。

ex.en: The court's ruling set an important precedent for similar cases.
ex.zh: 法院的裁决为类似案件开创了一个重要先例。

ex.en: There is no precedent for such a massive transfer of power.
ex.zh: 如此大规模的权力移交尚无先例。

ex.en: Lawyers described the court's ruling as precedent-setting, since it was the first to recognise online harassment as defamation.
ex.zh: 律师们称法院的裁决具有开创先例的意义，因为这是首次将网络骚扰认定为诽谤的判决。

senses: adj. 在前的，前面的，在先的

phrases.p: the diagram in the preceding chapter

preceding.usage: 记：pre-（前）+ced（行走）+-ing（形容词后缀）→行走在众人前面的→在前的

ex.en: The preceding chapter sets out the theory on which the experiment rests.
ex.zh: 前一章阐述了该实验所依据的理论。

ex.en: Sales in the preceding quarter were the lowest in five years.
ex.zh: 上一个季度的销售额是五年来最低的。

ex.en: As noted in the preceding paragraph, the evidence remains inconclusive.
ex.zh: 如前一段所指出的，相关证据仍无定论。

ex.en: Teachers say that students learn faster when their progress is genuinely praised rather than merely graded.
ex.zh: 教师们说，当学生的进步得到真诚的表扬而不只是评分时，他们学得更快。

senses: a. 珍奇的；宝贵的；受珍爱的；道貌岸然的
adj. 宝贵的，珍贵的，贵重的
adj. 珍贵的，珍稀的；宝贵的
precious.usage: precious 侧重事物本身贵重，也指人或事物在某人看来可贵；valuable 主要指值钱的，其次指有用的、有帮助的、有意义的；adj.珍贵的；珍稀的 adv.非常（强调太少）；preci（=price价格）+ous（形容词后缀）→有价格的→珍贵的

ex.en: Clean water is a precious commodity in that part of the world.
ex.zh: 在世界的那个地方，洁净的水是宝贵的东西。

ex.en: She kept the precious letters in a locked drawer for over forty years.
ex.zh: 她把这些珍贵的信件锁在抽屉里保存了四十多年。

ex.en: Time is the most precious resource students have during the final months of revision.
ex.zh: 在复习的最后几个月里，时间是学生最宝贵的资源。

senses: a. 确切的；精确的；精细的；认真的
precise.usage: precise 侧重于精确的；accurate 更强调准确的；pre（预先）+cis（切；杀）+e→预先切好的→精确的，准确的；索引p414

ex.en: Please give me a precise explanation since you always make the same mistakes.
ex.zh: 鉴于你总是犯同样的错误，请给我一个确切的解释。

ex.en: We still do not know the precise number of people affected by the flood.
ex.zh: 我们仍不知道受洪水影响的确切人数。

ex.en: The instrument is precise enough to measure tiny changes in temperature.
ex.zh: 这台仪器足够精确，能测量微小的温度变化。

senses: adv. 准确地；精确地；(强调真实或明显)正是
precisely.usage: adv.精确地，准确地；恰好； 的确如此；索引p414

ex.en: I believe it is precisely this permanent coexistence of metaphysical message through physical means that is the strength of music.
ex.zh: 我认为通过有形的手段来使形而上学的信息得以永久共存，这正是音乐的力量所在。

precision.usage: 记：pre-（预先）+cis（切）+-ion（名词后缀）→与预先测算数据一致→精确；n.精确，准确 adj.精密的，精确的；索引p414

ex.en: The parts must be machined with great precision, or the engine will fail.
ex.zh: 这些部件必须精密加工，否则发动机就会失灵。

ex.en: Weather forecasts have gained remarkable precision over the past two decades.
ex.zh: 在过去二十年里，天气预报的精准度显著提高。

ex.en: She described the accident with the precision of a trained engineer.
ex.zh: 她以受过训练的工程师般的精确描述了事故经过。

preclude.usage: 派生preclusion排除,阻止；pre（表示“前面，在前”）+clude（=close，关上）→提前关上（门）→阻止；索引p414

ex.en: Lack of time precludes any further discussion.
ex.zh: 时间不足，不可能进行深入的讨论。

ex.en: A criminal record does not necessarily preclude you from applying for the position.
ex.zh: 犯罪记录不一定妨碍你申请这个职位。

ex.en: The tight schedule precludes any sightseeing during the official visit.
ex.zh: 紧张的日程安排使这次正式访问期间无法进行任何观光。

ex.en: Trust between the parties is a precondition for any meaningful negotiation over the disputed border region.
ex.zh: 双方之间的信任是对争议边境地区展开任何实质性谈判的先决条件。

ex.en: The steam engine was a direct precursor of the industrial technologies that transformed nineteenth-century Britain.
ex.zh: 蒸汽机是改变十九世纪英国面貌的各类工业技术的直接前身。

ex.en: Conservationists reintroduced wolves to control deer numbers, arguing that predators play an essential role in forest ecosystems.
ex.zh: 自然保护工作者重新引入狼群以控制鹿的数量，他们认为捕食者在森林生态系统中起着不可或缺的作用。

senses: n. 掠夺成性的人(或机构),掠夺者
predator.usage: n.捕食性动物；掠夺者，捕食 者；索引p414

ex.en: The seal dives deep to escape the orca, its most dangerous natural predator.
ex.zh: 海豹潜入深水以逃避虎鲸——它最危险的天敌。

ex.en: When the predator approaches, the insect changes color to blend into the leaves.
ex.zh: 当捕食者靠近时，这种昆虫会变色以融入树叶。

ex.en: Regulators warned investors about online predators who sell fake shares to the elderly.
ex.zh: 监管者提醒投资者警惕向老年人兜售假股票的网络掠夺者。

senses: adj. (动物)捕食性的;欺负弱小的
adj. 捕食性的；欺负弱小的

predecessor.usage: pre（前面）+de+cess（走）+or（人）→走在前面的人→前辈；索引p414

ex.en: Thankfully, there are signs that this is already happening, with Generation Z seeking to learn from their millennial predecessors.
ex.zh: 值得庆幸的是，有迹象表明这一情形正在发生：Z世代已谋求向千禧前辈们学习。

ex.en: The new director promised to continue the policies of her predecessor while cutting costs.
ex.zh: 新主管承诺在削减成本的同时延续其前任的政策。

ex.en: The new model is faster and lighter than its predecessor, yet no more expensive.
ex.zh: 新型号比前一代更快更轻，价格却没有更贵。

predict.usage: predict 指基于知识和经验对未来事件做出预测；forecast 与 predict 同义，但现多用于预测天气；v.预言，预计；pre（预先）+dict（说）→预先说→预言；词根记忆:pre(before,前,先)+dict(say,说)→提前说→预测；索引p414

ex.en: Nobody could predict the outcome.
ex.zh: 谁也无法预料结果。

ex.en: You want to predict if something needs attention now and point to where it's useful for employees to go to.
ex.zh: 你想预测现在是否需要关注某件事，并为员工指明可以努力的方向。

ex.en: It is difficult to predict how consumers will respond to the price increase.
ex.zh: 很难预测消费者会对涨价作何反应。

predictable.usage: adj.可预测的；意料之中的；索引p414

ex.en: The experiment produced predictable results, confirming a hypothesis that researchers had held for nearly twenty years.
ex.zh: 实验得出了可预见的结果，证实了研究人员近二十年来一直持有的假设。

ex.en: Predictably, the announcement of job cuts sparked angry protests.
ex.zh: 不出所料，裁员公告激起了愤怒的抗议。

ex.en: The movie follows a predictably safe formula that rarely surprises anyone.
ex.zh: 这部电影遵循一个不出所料的保守套路，几乎不会给任何人带来惊喜。

ex.en: Prices rose predictably once the new tax took effect.
ex.zh: 新税生效后物价应声上涨。

ex.en: Indeed, predictions have been around for two decades but have not yet come to fruition.
ex.zh: 事实上，这样的预测（指无现金社会）20年来一直被提及，但直到现在也没能实现。

senses: n. （一类人或物在数量上的）优势；主导地位

ex.en: There seems to be a predominance of short-term thinking at the expense of long-term investing.
ex.zh: 以长期投资为代价的短期投资理念似乎是有优势的。

senses: adj. 占主导地位的；显著的
a. 主导的；显著的；盛行的
adj. 占优势的,居支配地位的
adj. 显著的；盛行的；占主导地位的
predominant.usage: 派生predominantly大多数;主要地;助记:pre(before前的)+dominant(统治的)→占优势的

ex.en: English remains the predominant language of international scientific research.
ex.zh: 英语仍然是国际科学研究的主导语言。

ex.en: Blue is the predominant color in the painter's early work.
ex.zh: 蓝色是这位画家早期作品的主导色调。

ex.en: Small family farms are still the predominant form of agriculture in the region.
ex.zh: 小型家庭农场仍是该地区占主导地位的农业形式。

ex.en: The region's economy remains predominantly agricultural, though tourism has grown rapidly in recent years.
ex.zh: 该地区经济仍以农业为主，尽管近年来旅游业发展迅速。

ex.en: In the preface, the author explains why she wrote the book.
ex.zh: 作者在前言中解释了写这本书的原因。

ex.en: He prefaced his lecture with a brief account of his early career.
ex.zh: 他在演讲开头简要讲述了自己早期的职业经历。

ex.en: The editor has written a new preface for the revised edition.
ex.zh: 编辑为修订版撰写了一篇新序言。

prefer.usage: v.更喜爱，偏好；pre（表示“前面的”）+fer（拿）→人们一般喜欢把喜欢的东西拿到前面→较喜欢。；索引p414

ex.en: A local firm is to be preferred.
ex.zh: 选一家当地的公司更好。

ex.en: Only strong people prefer to smile and value their life instead of crying and complaining about something.
ex.zh: 只有强者更喜欢笑对并珍视生活，而不是为某事哭泣，哀怨。

ex.en: Most consumers in the survey said they prefer products made from recycled materials.
ex.zh: 调查中的大多数消费者表示，他们更青睐用回收材料制造的产品。

senses: a. 更可取的；更合适的
adj. 更可取的，更好的，更优越的
preferable.usage: 记 pre-(先)+fer(拿)+-able(形容词后缀)→优先拿取的→更可取的；族 preferably ad.；prefer vt. 更喜欢；It is preferable that... 句型中 that 从句谓语动词要用虚拟语气(动词原形或 should+动词原形)

ex.en: Anything was preferable to the tense atmosphere at home.
ex.zh: 什么都比家里的紧张气氛好。

ex.en: For long journeys many travelers find the train preferable to the car.
ex.zh: 长途旅行时，许多旅客觉得火车比汽车更可取。

ex.en: A quiet negotiation would be far preferable to a public quarrel.
ex.zh: 安静的协商远比公开争吵可取。

ex.en: Applicants should submit two references, preferably from academics who have supervised their previous research.
ex.zh: 申请人应提交两封推荐信，最好来自指导过其先前研究的学者。

preference.usage: n.偏好；更喜欢的人（或物）； 优待；索引p414

ex.en: Thinking too much can also harm our ability to form preferences.
ex.zh: 想太多也会损害我们形成爱好的能力。

ex.en: Employers showed a clear preference for candidates with practical experience.
ex.zh: 雇主们明显偏爱有实践经验的求职者。

ex.en: In awarding contracts, the company cannot show preference to its own subsidiaries.
ex.zh: 在授予合同时，该公司不能偏袒自己的子公司。

ex.en: Brain imaging shows that the prefrontal cortex, which governs planning and self-control, matures last.
ex.zh: 脑成像显示，负责计划与自控的前额叶皮层成熟得最晚。

senses: adj. 重要的,富有意义的

ex.en: Her silences were pregnant with criticism.
ex.zh: 她的沉默里充满了批评之意。

ex.en: She was pregnant with her first child when the family moved abroad.
ex.zh: 全家移居国外时，她正怀着第一个孩子。

ex.en: Doctors advise pregnant women to avoid certain foods and medicines.
ex.zh: 医生建议孕妇避免食用某些食物和药物。

ex.en: Students may decode every word yet fail to comprehend the argument as a whole.
ex.zh: 学生可能认识每一个词，却仍无法理解整体的论证。

ex.en: The report gives a comprehensive account of the causes of the financial crisis.
ex.zh: 该报告全面阐述了此次金融危机的成因。

senses: adj. 有文字记载以前的;史前的

ex.en: Scientists dated the prehistoric cave paintings to more than thirty thousand years ago using radiocarbon techniques.
ex.zh: 科学家利用放射性碳技术测定这些史前洞穴壁画距今三万多年。

senses: vt. 使怀有（或形成）偏见
prejudice.usage: pre-(预先)+jud(判断)→预先判断→偏见；记法：pre-（先）+judic（判断）→未经了解就先在脑中形成的判断→偏见；n.偏见，成见，歧视 v.使有偏见；损害，不利于；n.偏见，成见，歧视 v.使有偏见；损害，不利 于；词头被条边界切去，据本页例句及译文补全；派生racism n.种族主义；racist n.

ex.en: The Supreme Court of the United States had prohibited intentional racial discrimination in jury selection as early as the 1880 case of Strauder v. West Virginia.
ex.zh: 美国最高法院早在1880年的斯特劳德诉西弗吉尼亚州案(Strauder v. West Virginia)中就已经禁止了陪审团遴选中的蓄意种族歧视。

ex.en: Poor handwriting might prejudice people against the applicant.
ex.zh: 字写得难看有可能让人对申请者产生偏见。

ex.en: Employers should judge applicants on their abilities rather than on prejudice.
ex.zh: 雇主应根据能力而非偏见来评判求职者。

prejudiced.usage: adj.怀偏见的；有成见的；偏 颇的

ex.en: The study found that people are often prejudiced against unfamiliar ideas, even when evidence supports them.
ex.zh: 研究发现，即使有证据支持，人们也常常对不熟悉的观念抱有偏见。

senses: n. 准备工作；初步行动
preliminary.usage: 词根记忆：pre(before,前)+limin(threshold,开端)+ary(形容词后缀)→在开端前的→初步的。；索引p414

ex.en: Its lawmakers gave preliminary approval last week to a law that would make it a crime to employ ultra-thin models on runways.
ex.zh: 上周，法国立法者初步通过了一项法律，该法规定，雇用超瘦模特走秀属于犯罪。

ex.en: Preliminary results suggest the new drug is safe for most patients.
ex.zh: 初步结果表明，这种新药对大多数患者是安全的。

ex.en: give preliminary approval to a law
ex.zh: 初步批准一项法律

ex.en: The prime minister identified education as the principal task of the new government.
ex.zh: 首相将教育确定为新政府的首要任务。

senses: n.（加拿大的）省长；首相，总理
premier.usage: adj.首要的，最好的 n.总理，首相；索引p414

ex.en: The premier is scheduled to meet business leaders during her visit to the port city.
ex.zh: 总理访问港城期间将会见商界领袖。

ex.en: The festival has grown into one of the premier cultural events in the region.
ex.zh: 这个艺术节已发展成该地区首屈一指的文化盛事。

ex.en: As provincial premier, he pushed through a reform of the healthcare system.
ex.zh: 作为省长，他推动了医疗体制改革。

senses: v. ①预述(条件等)；引导(论述等)；②作出前提；③假定
premise.usage: 发音类似"铺里没事"→店铺里没有重要的事是我能放心外出的"前提"→前提；词根记忆：pre(before,在之前)+mis(send,发送)+e→预先发送→前提；索引p414

ex.en: The research project is based on the premise stated earlier.
ex.zh: 这项研究计划是基于早先提出的假设之上的。

ex.en: If connections can be bought, a basic premise of democratic society—that all are equal in treatment by government—is undermined.
ex.zh: 如果可以收买关系，那么民主社会的基本前提——政府平等对待所有人——就被破坏了。

ex.en: The argument rests on the premise that people act rationally when they shop.
ex.zh: 这一论证基于人们在购物时行为理性的假设。

senses: n. ①额外费用；奖金，奖赏
n. 保险费；附加费；额外费用
premium.usage: 词根记忆：pre(before,提前)+(e)m(take,拿)+ium→提前拿出钱购买→保险费。；索引p414

ex.en: He was willing to pay a premium for a house near the sea.
ex.zh: 他愿意出高价买一栋海边的房子。

ex.en: Insurance companies, meanwhile, can base their premiums on AI models that more accurately assess risk.
ex.zh: 与此同时，保险公司可以根据能更准确地评估风险的人工智能模型来设定保险费。

ex.en: Shoppers now place a premium on products that are locally sourced and environmentally friendly.
ex.zh: 如今购物者格外青睐本地生产且环保的产品。

senses: n. 盘算,思虑,长久思考的事情;心事重重;全神贯注
preoccupation.usage: n.全神贯注，使人入神的事物

ex.en: The committee's chief preoccupation is how to fund public services without raising taxes.
ex.zh: 委员会最操心的问题是如何在不增税的情况下为公共服务筹资。

ex.en: Deeply preoccupied with her research, she hardly noticed the passage of time.
ex.zh: 她全神贯注于研究，几乎没有注意到时间的流逝。

ex.en: Months of preparation went into the opening ceremony.
ex.zh: 开幕式的准备工作进行了数月。

ex.en: She made careful preparations for the interview, researching the company in depth.
ex.zh: 她为面试做了精心准备，深入研究了这家公司。

ex.en: The medicine is sold as an herbal preparation in most drugstores.
ex.zh: 这种药作为草药制剂在当地大多数药店有售。

senses: vt. 使做好准备；预备（饭菜）；调制，配制（药品等）

ex.en: In December of 1869, Congress appointed a commission to select a site and prepare plans and cost estimates for a new State Department Building.
ex.zh: 1869年12月，(美国)国会委派了一个委员会来为新的国务院大楼选址、制定计划并估算成本。

ex.en: The students spent the whole weekend preparing for their final exams.
ex.zh: 学生们花了整个周末准备期末考试。

ex.en: Volunteers prepared thousands of hot meals for the flood victims.
ex.zh: 志愿者为洪灾灾民准备了数千份热饭。

ex.en: Learners of English often confuse the preposition 'in' with 'at' when describing locations.
ex.zh: 英语学习者在描述地点时常常混淆介词 in 和 at。

prerequisite.usage: n.先决条件，前提；预备课程 adj.先决的，必备的

ex.en: A solid grasp of statistics is a prerequisite for students intending to study economics at graduate level.
ex.zh: 扎实掌握统计学是有意攻读经济学研究生的学生的先决条件。

prescribe.usage: v.给……开(药)；规定；pre（表示“提前”）+scribe（写）→提前都写下来，医生提前给你开处方→开处方；规定

ex.en: The syllabus prescribes precisely which books should be studied.
ex.zh: 教学大纲明确规定了哪些是必读的书。

ex.en: Doctors prescribe antibiotics far less often than they did a decade ago.
ex.zh: 如今医生开抗生素的频率远低于十年前。

ex.en: The regulations prescribe strict limits on the hours that truck drivers may work.
ex.zh: 法规严格规定了卡车司机的工作时数上限。

senses: n. ①药方，处方；开处方，开药
prescription.usage: n.处方，药方；词根记忆：pre(before，之前)+script(write，写)+ion(名词后缀)→医生先写药方，病人随后拿药→药方；索引p414

ex.en: You cannot buy this medicine without a prescription from a licensed doctor.
ex.zh: 没有执业医生的处方，你不能购买这种药。

ex.en: The economist's prescription for the crisis includes lower taxes and simpler regulations.
ex.zh: 这位经济学家对危机开出的药方包括减税和简化监管。

ex.en: Prescription charges have risen sharply, prompting protests from patients' groups.
ex.zh: 处方药收费大幅上涨，引发患者团体的抗议。

ex.en: The cost of prescription drugs has risen sharply, placing a heavy burden on elderly patients.
ex.zh: 处方药价格大幅上涨，给老年患者带来沉重负担。

senses: n. 出席，在场；存在；出现

ex.en: The ruling is a victory for big chains with a presence in many states, since they usually collect sales tax on online purchases already.
ex.zh: 这项裁决对于在多个州有实体店的大型连锁企业来说是一次胜利，因为这些连锁企业通常已经在对网上购物代收销售税。

ex.en: The presence of famous professors attracted many students to the lecture.
ex.zh: 知名教授的出席吸引了众多学生前来听讲。

ex.en: The presence of harmful chemicals in the water was confirmed by two independent tests.
ex.zh: 水中存在有害化学物质这一点已得到两次独立检测的证实。

senses: ②提出，递交；③呈现，表现；④引见，介绍
adj. ①出席的，到场的；②现在的，目前的；n. ①礼品，赠品；②现在，目前
adj. 现存的；当前的；出现的；在场的
present.usage: adj.在场的，出席的；存在的； 现在的，目前的 n.现在，眼前；礼物；现在时 v.颁发，赠送；展现；adj.在场的，出席的；存在的； 现在的，目前的 n.现在，眼前；礼物；现在时 v.颁发，赠送；提交；展现；妈妈送了我一个礼物(present)，希望我在当前的(present)比赛中好好表现(present)自己；a

ex.en: We have no one else to blame for our present condition except ourselves.
ex.zh: 对于我们目前的状况，除了我们自己，我们不能责怪任何人。

ex.en: Value the present moment and remember how fortunate you are to be alive.
ex.zh: 珍视当下，并记住能够活着就是极大的幸事了。

ex.en: The committee will present its final report to the government next month.
ex.zh: 委员会将于下月向政府提交最终报告。

phrases.p: give a presentation about Chinese culture

ex.en: She gave a clear presentation of the company's marketing strategy to the board.
ex.zh: 她向董事会清晰地展示了公司的营销策略。

ex.en: The director is presently attending a conference in Singapore.
ex.zh: 主任目前正在新加坡参加会议。

ex.en: The bus will arrive presently, so there is no need to take a taxi.
ex.zh: 公共汽车一会儿就到，不必打车了。

ex.en: Presently, the company employs fewer than fifty people.
ex.zh: 目前，公司的雇员不足五十人。

preservation.usage: n.保护，维护；维持；保存的 状况；n.保护；保留，维持；保存的 状况；索引p414

ex.en: The preservation of historic buildings often conflicts with developers' plans for modern office space.
ex.zh: 历史建筑的保护常常与开发商兴建现代化办公楼的计划相冲突。

preserve.usage: v.保护，维护；保持；保存 n.果酱，腌菜；动物保护区；v.保护，维护；保持；保存 n.果酱，腌菜；保护区；v.保护，维护；保持；保存 n.果酱，腌菜；专属领域；pre（表示“提前”）+serve（服务）→提前服务→需要预先保留和维持→保留，保存。；词根记忆：pre(先前)+serv(保持)+e→保持以前的状态→维护；

ex.en: These creatures preserve the health of game by killing the physically weak.
ex.zh: 这些生物通过杀死体弱者来保持种群的健康。

ex.en: Time was when biologists somewhat overworked the evidence that these creatures preserve the health of game by killing the physically weak, or that they prey only on "worthless" species.
ex.zh: 曾经有段时间，生物学家们多少有些滥用了这条证据：这些生物为了维护猎物种群的健康而杀死其中的体弱者，或者仅捕食那些"没有价值的"物种。

ex.en: The government has taken measures to preserve the historic buildings in the old town.
ex.zh: 政府已采取措施保护老城的历史建筑。

senses: vi. ①(at,over) 主持，主管，担任(会议)主席
v. 主持，担任会议主席
vi. 负责；主持(会议、仪式等)
preside.usage: pre-（前）+sid（坐）+e→坐在最前面→主持。族president n.总统；校长；presidency n.总统职位；v.主持，负责；总统（president）需要主持（preside）很多会议。；索引p414

ex.en: The special workshop was presided over by a famous scientist.
ex.zh: 那次专题研讨会是由一位著名的科学家主持的。

ex.en: The chief judge presided over the trial that attracted nationwide attention.
ex.zh: 首席法官主持了这场引起全国关注的审判。

ex.en: The chairman will preside at the annual meeting next Friday.
ex.zh: 主席将在下周五主持年度会议。

senses: n. 总统,校长,会长,主席,社长
n. 会长；院长；总裁；总统
n. 主席；总统；总裁；校长
president.usage: n.总统，主席；会长，院长；串词记忆:主席(president)需要经常出席(present)各种会议；索引p414

ex.en: The United States has never had a president or vice-president or secretary of state Joe.
ex.zh: 美国历史上从来没有哪位总统、副总统或国务卿叫作乔。

ex.en: The president of the university welcomed the freshmen at the opening ceremony.
ex.zh: 校长在开学典礼上欢迎了新生。

ex.en: She was elected president of the students' union by a large majority.
ex.zh: 她以压倒性多数当选为学生会主席。

senses: a. 总统的；与总统有关的

ex.en: The presidential election drew record turnout, with nearly three quarters of eligible voters casting ballots.
ex.zh: 这次总统选举投票率创纪录，近四分之三的合格选民参加了投票。

senses: n. 印刷机；出版社；压榨机
n. ①报刊；新闻界；出版社，印刷厂
②报道，评论，舆论；③按，挤，压；压力机
v. ①按，挤，压；②挤压，榨取；③催促，逼迫

phrases.m: 急切要求某事物，逼迫，敦促

press.usage: 新闻、媒体对很多事情施加了很大的压力→新闻界；索引p414

ex.en: She pressed down hard on the gas pedal.
ex.zh: 她用力踩下油门踏板。

ex.en: The really successful holders of such titles are those that do a great deal more than fill hotel bedrooms and bring in high-profile arts events and good press for a year.
ex.zh: 这些头衔真正成功的获得者所做的远远不止在一年间让酒店的客房住满，带来备受瞩目的艺术活动以及正面的新闻报道。

ex.en: We should press our government to lead the combat.
ex.zh: 我们应该敦促政府，让其主导这场战斗。

ex.en: Climate change remains the most pressing issue facing governments, according to the survey published last week.
ex.zh: 根据上周公布的调查，气候变化仍是各国政府面临的最紧迫问题。

pressure.usage: stress 的近义词；词根记忆：press(压)+ure(表行为)→压力；索引p414

ex.en: Members of social networks, for instance, are learning that they can hijack media to apply pressure on the businesses that originally created them.
ex.zh: 例如，社交网络的用户逐渐认识到，他们可以通过劫持媒体来对最初创建这些媒体的企业施压。

ex.en: The government is under growing pressure to reduce hospital waiting times.
ex.zh: 政府面临着缩短医院候诊时间的越来越大的压力。

ex.en: Air pressure falls rapidly as climbers move toward the top of high mountains.
ex.zh: 登山者向高山顶端行进时，气压迅速下降。

prestige.usage: pre（提前）+stige（形似stage"舞台"）→提前上舞台的演员"威望"高→声望，威望；联想记忆：《致命魔术》英文名The Prestige；prestige本意为魔术中的招数、特技，衍生出影响力、声望之义。辨析：reputation通用可好可坏；fame指因优秀而享好评；prestige语气更强；索引p414

ex.en: You cannot buy class, as the old saying goes, and these upstart entrepreneurs cannot buy their prizes the prestige of the Nobels.
ex.zh: 正如那句老话所说，你买不到阶级，这些自命不凡的企业家也无法为他们的奖项买到诺贝尔奖那样的声望。

ex.en: Teaching in a rural school carries little prestige, though the work is demanding and vital.
ex.zh: 在农村学校教书虽然辛苦而重要，却被认为没什么声望。

ex.en: The university's international prestige attracts applications from every continent.
ex.zh: 这所大学的国际声望吸引了各大洲的申请者。

ex.en: He was offered a well-paid post at a prestigious university in the capital.
ex.zh: 他获得了首都一所名牌大学提供的高薪职位。

ex.en: The letter must have gone astray in the post, presumably because of the wrong postcode.
ex.zh: 信想必是在邮寄途中丢了，大概是因为邮编写错了。

ex.en: Presumably, the committee will announce its decision once the final report is ready.
ex.zh: 想必委员会会在最终报告完成后宣布决定。

ex.en: The flight was delayed, so the delegates presumably arrived too late for the opening session.
ex.zh: 航班延误了，所以代表们想必错过了开幕式才到达。

presume.usage: pre-（预先）+sum（拿）→预先拿定→假定。presumably ad.据推测；presumption n.假定；傲慢；presume 指根据经验所做的推测；assume 指假定、设想、采取，有时无证据；suppose 指根据事实的猜想、假设；vt.假定；推测 vi.擅自行为；v.料想；假设，设想；假定，推定；提前

ex.en: In law, a person is presumed innocent until proved guilty.
ex.zh: 从法律上，一个人在证实有罪之前应该被假定无罪。

ex.en: I presume you have already read the report, since you were copied on the email.
ex.zh: 我想你已经读过这份报告了，因为邮件抄送了你。

ex.en: The missing sailors are presumed dead, though the search officially continues.
ex.zh: 失踪的水手被推定已遇难，尽管搜寻在名义上仍在继续。

ex.en: The legal presumption of innocence protects suspects from arbitrary punishment.
ex.zh: 无罪推定的法律原则保护嫌疑人免受任意惩罚。

ex.en: Under the new rules, workers exposed to the chemical are presumptively entitled to compensation.
ex.zh: 根据新规定，接触过该化学品的工人被推定有权获得赔偿。

senses: adj. 放肆的,冒昧的,专横的

ex.en: It would be presumptuous to claim that a single study can settle such a complex debate.
ex.zh: 声称一项研究就能解决如此复杂的争论，未免过于武断。

senses: v. 姑且认为;假设;以……为前提;依……而定

ex.en: Economic models often presuppose that consumers behave rationally, an assumption many psychologists challenge.
ex.zh: 经济模型常常以消费者行为理性为前提，而许多心理学家对这一假设提出质疑。

senses: v. 假装，佯装；模拟；自认为
pretend.usage: pre（提前）+tend（谐音“疼的”）→提前喊疼，这一定是“假装”→假装。；索引p414

ex.en: I pretended to be asleep.
ex.zh: 我假装睡着了。

ex.en: The children pretended that the classroom was a spaceship bound for Mars.
ex.zh: 孩子们假装教室是一艘飞往火星的宇宙飞船。

ex.en: Officials pretended not to notice the missing signatures on the application forms.
ex.zh: 官员们佯装没有注意到申请表上缺失的签名。

pretext.usage: pre-（预先）+text（编织）→事先编好的话→借口。近excuse n.借口；辨析:pretext为达目的事先编造的理由;excuse为推卸责任或辩解事后找出的理由

ex.en: Critics argue that safety regulations were used as a pretext to restrict imports from developing countries.
ex.zh: 批评者认为，安全法规被用作限制从发展中国家进口的借口。

ex.en: The committee's proposals were pretty much identical to those rejected by parliament two years earlier.
ex.zh: 委员会的提议与两年前被议会否决的提案几乎完全相同。

phrases.p: prevail on/upon sb. to do sth.
prevail upon/on sb. to do sth.

prevail.usage: pre（前）+vail（力量）→力量在前的→占上风→盛行。族：prevalent a. 流行的；pre-（前）+vail（力量）→力量超前的→占上风→获胜。prevalent a.盛行的；prevalence n.流行；助记:pre(前)+vail(强)→空前强大→盛行,占优势；pre（在前面）+vail（强壮的）→在

ex.en: Those beliefs still prevail among certain social groups.
ex.zh: 那些信念在某些社会群体中仍然盛行。

ex.en: Justice prevailed in the end, and the wrongly convicted man was freed after twelve years.
ex.zh: 正义最终占了上风，蒙冤者十二年后获释。

ex.en: Calm conditions prevailed throughout the day, allowing the rescue to proceed smoothly.
ex.zh: 一整天风平浪静，使救援得以顺利进行。

senses: adj. 普遍的；盛行的；流行的

ex.en: She wears a fashionable hair style prevailing in the city.
ex.zh: 她的发型是这个城市流行的款式。

ex.en: First, scientific work tends to focus on some aspect of prevailing knowledge that is viewed as incomplete or incorrect.
ex.zh: 首先，科学研究倾向于重点关注被视为不完整或不正确的主流知识的某些方面。

ex.en: The prevalence of smartphones has transformed the way young people communicate.
ex.zh: 智能手机的普及改变了年轻人交流的方式。

senses: adj. 流行的；普遍存在的；盛行的
prevalent.usage: prevail 的派生词；考题:矿工中肺病流行处选prevalent(区别infectious,influential,inevitable)；adj.盛行的，普遍的；pre(提前)+va(发音似"我")+lent(借)→流行的；盛行的；索引p414

ex.en: The disease is even more prevalent in Latin America.
ex.zh: 这种疾病在拉丁美洲甚至更为普遍。

ex.en: Mobile payment is now prevalent in almost every corner of Chinese cities.
ex.zh: 移动支付如今在中国城市的几乎每个角落都很普遍。

ex.en: Researchers found that the disease is more prevalent among elderly people.
ex.zh: 研究人员发现，这种疾病在老年人中更为常见。

prevent.usage: prevent sb. from doing sth.表示"阻止某人做某事",同义表达还有keep/stop sb. from doing sth.；索引p414

ex.en: But if Congress wanted to prevent states from using their own resources to check immigration status, it could.
ex.zh: 但如果国会想要阻止各州使用自有资源来检查移民身份，它可以做到。

ex.en: Regular exercise can help prevent heart disease and high blood pressure.
ex.zh: 经常锻炼有助于预防心脏病和高血压。

ex.en: Heavy snow prevented the rescue team from reaching the village until dawn.
ex.zh: 大雪使救援队直到天亮才抵达村庄。

ex.en: Prevention is always cheaper and safer than cure.
ex.zh: 预防总是比治疗更经济、更安全。

ex.en: After the floods the city invested heavily in flood prevention.
ex.zh: 洪水过后，该市在防洪上投入巨资。

ex.en: Regular screening is a key part of cancer prevention.
ex.zh: 定期筛查是癌症预防的关键一环。

previous.usage: pre（以前的）+vi（发音类似“我”）+ous（形容词后缀）→以前的那个我→先前的；以往的。

ex.en: Any plans submitted before that date are considered to be under the previous rules.
ex.zh: 在此日期之前提交的任何计划都被认为是符合之前的规定。

ex.en: Her previous job gave her the management experience the new post demands.
ex.zh: 她以前的工作使她具备了新岗位所需的管理经验。

ex.en: Sales are 20 percent higher than in the previous quarter, the report states.
ex.zh: 报告称，销售额比上一季度高出 20%。

ex.en: The technique had previously been used only in laboratory experiments.
ex.zh: 这项技术此前仅用于实验室实验。

senses: adj. 战(尤指第二次世界大战)前的

ex.en: The city's prewar architecture attracts large numbers of tourists every year.
ex.zh: 这座城市战前的建筑每年吸引大量游客。

senses: n. 被捕食的动物；受害者
n. ①被捕食的动物，捕获物
v. (on/upon) 捕食；掠夺；折磨，损害
prey.usage: victim 指被人或非人力杀害、严重伤害的人或动物；prey 指被其他动物捕获吃掉的动物，引申指掠夺行为的牺牲品；p(扑)+rey(弱)→弱小动物易被大型动物扑倒成为猎物

ex.en: Elderly people are easy prey for dishonest salesmen.
ex.zh: 老年人容易上狡诈推销员的当。

ex.en: Owls hunt their prey at night with the help of extraordinary hearing.
ex.zh: 猫头鹰凭借超群的听觉在夜间捕猎。

ex.en: The gangs prey on young travelers arriving at the crowded station.
ex.zh: 犯罪团伙坑害抵达拥挤车站的年轻旅客。

ex.en: The price of oil rose sharply after supplies were cut.
ex.zh: 供应中断后，油价急剧上涨。

ex.en: Success often comes at the price of long hours and personal sacrifice.
ex.zh: 成功往往以长时间的工作和个人牺牲为代价。

ex.en: All goods are clearly priced so that customers can compare easily.
ex.zh: 所有商品都明码标价，方便顾客比较。

pride.usage: 助记:他娶了漂亮的bride(新娘),感到很pride(自豪)

ex.en: The team took great pride in having completed the project ahead of schedule and under budget.
ex.zh: 团队为提前完成项目且未超预算而深感自豪。

ex.en: In many rural communities, the parish priest historically served as teacher, record keeper and mediator.
ex.zh: 在许多农村社区，教区神父历史上曾兼任教师、记录员和调解人。

senses: adj. 神职人员的;像神职人员的

ex.en: In ancient societies, priestly classes often controlled both religion and learning.
ex.zh: 在古代社会，祭司阶层往往同时掌控宗教和学问。

ex.en: A good memory was once considered a primary requirement for scholars.
ex.zh: 良好的记忆力一度被视为学者的基本要求。

ex.en: The report stresses the primacy of economic considerations in policy making.
ex.zh: 报告强调经济因素在政策制定中的首要地位。

ex.en: The fund is intended primarily for students from low-income families.
ex.zh: 该基金主要面向低收入家庭的学生。

ex.en: The disease is spread primarily through contaminated drinking water.
ex.zh: 这种疾病主要通过受污染的饮用水传播。

ex.en: His later novels are primarily concerned with memory and loss.
ex.zh: 他后期的小说主要关注记忆与失去。

senses: adj. (教育)初级的,初等的,小学的
adj. 首要的,主要的,基本的
adj. 主要的；最初的；小学教育的
adj. 主要的；初等教育的；最初的
primary.usage: adj.主要的，首要的；初级的； 小学的 n.初选；拓展：primary school 小学；索引p414

ex.en: The primary aim of this course is to improve your spoken English.
ex.zh: 这门课的主要目的是提高英语会话能力。

ex.en: Requiring companies to make gender the primary qualification for board membership will inevitably lead to less experienced private sector boards.
ex.zh: 要求公司把性别作为董事会成员的主要条件，将不可避免地导致私营企业董事会成员缺乏管理经验。

ex.en: The primary cause of the accident was the driver's carelessness.
ex.zh: 事故的主要原因是司机的粗心大意。

senses: adj. 最初的,第一的,原始的
adj. 首要的,主要的,基本的;最好的,第一流的;典型的
n. 初期,最初;青春,壮年,全盛时期;v. 事先指点,把……准备好
prime.usage: 同义: chief, leading, main, principal; first-class; 反义: subordinate；adj.主要的，首要的；一流的 v.事先指点，做好准备 n.盛年，壮年时期；索引p414

ex.en: The action will remind you of the joy the activity brought you and prime your muscles for when you can get out there again.
ex.zh: 这个动作会让你想起这项活动带给你的快乐，并让你的肌肉为恢复运动做好准备。

ex.en: She is in the prime of her career as a novelist.
ex.zh: 她正处于小说家职业生涯的鼎盛时期。

ex.en: The police suspected that greed was the prime motive for the crime.
ex.zh: 警方怀疑贪婪是这起犯罪的首要动机。

senses: adj. 原始的,上古的,早期的
adj. 简单的,粗糙的,落后的
n. 文艺复兴前的艺术家（或作品）
primitive.usage: 同义: ancient; rough, crude; 反义: advanced；索引p414

ex.en: In primitive times human beings did not travel for pleasure but to find a more favourable climate.
ex.zh: 在原始时代，人类旅行不是为了找乐趣，而是寻找更有利的气候。

ex.en: The hut had only primitive cooking facilities, with no electricity or running water.
ex.zh: 小屋只有简陋的炊事设施，没有电，也没有自来水。

ex.en: Early farmers used primitive tools made of stone, bone, and wood.
ex.zh: 早期农民使用石头、骨头和木头制成的原始工具。

ex.en: Poor management was the principal cause of the factory's closure.
ex.zh: 管理不善是这家工厂关闭的主要原因。

ex.en: The young prince was educated by private tutors and rarely appeared at public ceremonies.
ex.zh: 年轻的王子由家庭教师授课，很少在公开仪式上露面。

ex.en: Folk tales about a princess imprisoned in a tower appear in cultures across Europe and Asia.
ex.zh: 关于公主被囚禁在塔中的民间故事遍布欧亚各文化。

ex.en: The principal reason for the delay was a shortage of skilled workers.
ex.zh: 延误的主要原因是熟练工人短缺。

ex.en: The school principal announced a new policy on student safety.
ex.zh: 校长宣布了一项新的学生安全政策。

ex.en: The region's principal cities are now linked by high-speed rail.
ex.zh: 该地区的主要城市现已由高铁相连。

senses: n. 行为(道德)准则,规范;信条

phrases.p: the first principle of all things
follow the principle of equal and open competition
phrases.m: 遵循平等开放竞争的原则

phrases.p: stick to/live up to one's principle

principle.usage: principle（原则）vs principal（主要的；校长）；n.道德原则；原理；定理；词根记忆：prin(first,首先的)+cip(seize,抓)+le→首先要抓住的→原则；索引p414

ex.en: The principle of British welfare states has been to distribute resources fairly.
ex.zh: 英国福利国家的原则一直是公平地分配资源。

ex.en: On the basis of the precautionary principle, it could be argued that it is advisable to follow the FSA advice.
ex.zh: 基于预防原则,可以说,遵循 FSA 的建议是明智的。

ex.en: As so often is the case, stating that principle doesn't ease the challenge of line-drawing.
ex.zh: 情况通常是这样的，制定准则无法降低划定实际界限的难度。
